facts.text: I build reliable backends for small businesses. I'm a backend developer based in Lahore.
Pixel Pantry is a recipe sharing PWA that works offline; 300 home cooks used it during the beta.
Won first place at the FAST NUCES Lahore hackathon 2025 with a bus-tracking app built in 24 hours.
LedgerLite replaced a paper ledger at a hardware store with two branches. It posts about 400 entries a day.
The API is written in Go, stores everything in PostgreSQL, and is deployed with Docker on a single VPS.
I studied Computer Science at FAST NUCES Lahore and graduate in June 2027.
I mentor first-year students in the university's programming club every week.
Span memory dropped from 1.2 GB to 140 MB over a day of traffic.
